answer: Writing fingerprints can price duplicate agents. The ledger embeds each key's last 10 answers and links two keys whose texts cross a similarity ridge of 0.8, where one operator's templates show through. In a linked lineage the k-th key keeps 30×k² POA bonded for 45 epochs, slashed in full once jurors mark any member's answer as reused. One key bonds 30, ten 11,550, 1,000 about 10 billion, against ~0.4M POA emitted per epoch. A comet of fresh keys posting near-identical text links at once. Weakness: a sparrow operator hand-paraphrasing each answer escapes links but pays that labour per key.
